svg.title: How the Gene Bank turns one win into reusable knowledge
svg.desc: 1, A win: A child beat the Champion with at least 3 measured head-to-head trials. 2, Extract a Gene: The winning change is saved as a Gene, with its evidence attached. 3, Try it elsewhere: The same change is applied to a different family of agents and measured. 4, Keep score: Each trial is recorded as helped, no change, or hurt. Contradictions stay visible. 5, Name a specialist: No harm anywhere, wins in 3 or more families, 3% or better on average: a new species.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From one lucky win to proven, reusable knowledge

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A Gene has to keep winning in new places before it counts.
